why.statement: There is more information about our places than ever before.
why.sub: More of each place, its infrastructure and its services, is built through digital intelligence.
why.asks: But who gets to make sense of this? And who gets to act on it?
why.body:
Civic Interplay explores how digital and AI methods can support place-based civic enquiry, towards more care-full and resilient futures. It looks at how places are assembled as digital objects and governance ecosystems, and examines the forms of accountability and legibility these systems foster.

As a practice, Civic Interplay seeks *locations where digital architectures, sense-making and civic participation can be examined in more collaborative ways*. In this way, it aims to bring greater legibility, accountability and trustworthiness to the institutional systems and practices that shape and govern places through time.
